description: WRITES. Replaces the caller's private holdings list with the whole list the user gives (symbols, optional weight %), at most 50. An empty list clears it and needs confirm: true. Never guess a holding.

confirm.description: Must be true to clear the list with an empty array; ignored otherwise.

holdings.description: The WHOLE list — it replaces the stored one. Empty clears it (with confirm: true).

symbol.description: Ticker, e.g. 'NVDA', 'XLP', 'SAP.DE'; FX as the 6-letter pair, futures by root behind a slash (/HG), coins by their USD pair (BTCUSD).

weight.description: Optional share of the portfolio in percent, > 0 and ≤ 100.

name: set_my_holdings
